svg.aria-label: Telemetry flow of the OtelSpark observability framework. Spark pipelines run in a Docker container; OtelSparkListener turns Spark events into spans, OpenTelemetryAppender turns log4j2 logs into OTel log records carrying the run's trace_id, and the OpenTelemetry Java agent adds JVM metrics and ships everything over OTLP gRPC to an OpenTelemetry Collector. The collector writes to Elasticsearch data streams, viewed in a Kibana dashboard, and to raw JSON files read by SparkApp. A failed task marks its stage, job, SQL execution and application spans as ERROR. Datadog is an optional extra exporter.
svg.text: OtelSpark observability framework — how telemetry flows
Spans, logs and metrics from every Spark run, linked by trace_id, searchable in Elasticsearch and Kibana (all open source, all in Docker)
SQL spans labelled READ / JOIN / AGG / WRITE
ERROR spans ride the traces lane: status=ERROR · error=true
Run it: make up (Elasticsearch + Kibana + collector + dashboard) · make load (simulator) · Kibana on localhost:5601
